# ankra_organisation_dns_zone (Data Source)

The organisation's own delegated DNS zone, which `ankra_organisation_dns_record` names hang off. The counterpart of `ankra org dns zone`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_organisation_dns_zone" "this" {}

output "zone" {
  value = data.ankra_organisation_dns_zone.this.fqdn
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String) Zone FQDN; empty while no zone exists.
- `id` (String) The zone FQDN.
- `state` (String) `active`, `pending`, or `none` when the organisation has no zone yet.
